description: Portal frontend: pod detail panel (containers table, log viewer with container select, tail 50/100/200/500, previous toggle, Refresh, monospace output, redaction note, empty/error states) and expandable ArgoCD app rows with Helm/ArgoCD detail and the 'no helm list' help text. Covers plan.md items 15 and 16. Depends on FEAT-003: read its findings for the exact response field names before writing types.ts. Tests use renderToStaticMarkup (node environment, no effects), so each feature is a pure presentational component plus a thin useLoadable container.
steps: Read FEAT-003.json findings first and copy the exact field names into types.ts (ContainerRow, ContainersResponse, LogsResponse, ArgoAppDetail, ArgoAppDetailResponse) and api.ts (containers, logs, argoAppDetail).

Item 15: create components\ContainersTable.tsx (pure), LogsView.tsx (pure), PodDetail.tsx (container with useLoadable, container select, tail select 50/100/200/500, previous checkbox disabled when restart_count is 0, Refresh, Close); edit PodTable.tsx (Details button, keep Diagnose and its aria-label), ClusterDetail.tsx (detailPod state reset on cluster or namespace change), styles.css, tone.ts if needed; fixtures src\test-fixtures\containers.sample.json and logs.sample.json; tests ContainersTable.test.tsx and LogsView.test.tsx (including HTML escaping of a <script> log line and the always-present redaction note); extend fixtures-boundary.test.ts without changing existing tests.

Item 16: create components\ArgoAppDetailView.tsx (pure: source, images, sync and health, last operation, history up to 10, out-of-sync resources, help text 'ArgoCD renders Helm charts itself, so there is no helm list here.'), ArgoAppRow.tsx (container, loads on expand, ErrorBanner and EmptyState for non-ok statuses); edit ArgoPanel.tsx (Details toggle per row, second <tr> with colSpan, existing branches unchanged); styles.css; fixture src\test-fixtures\argocd-detail.sample.json; test ArgoAppDetailView.test.tsx.
Respect strict TypeScript (noUncheckedIndexedAccess is on): index arrays with a fallback. No new npm packages. No fabricated rows: every empty state is explicit.
acceptance_criteria: types.ts and api.ts match the backend field names recorded in FEAT-003 findings

The pod detail panel shows a containers table (kind, image tag or digest, ready, restarts, state with reason and exit code, probes) and a logs section with container select, tail options 50/100/200/500, a previous toggle, a Refresh button, a monospace <pre>, the visible note 'Logs are redacted best-effort. Do not treat them as safe to share.', and explicit idle, loading, empty and error states

The ArgoCD panel has an expandable row per app that shows source (repo, chart or path, target revision), images, last operation, up to 10 history entries, out-of-sync resources, and the Helm help text; non-ok ArgoCD statuses show the backend message
No runtime file imports a test fixture; fixtures-boundary.test.ts covers the new fixture names
cd frontend && npm test && npm run build passes (or is recorded UNVERIFIED with the commands)
verification: cd c:/Devops/Repository/Developer-friendly-infra/frontend && npm run build   (runs tsc -b, the type check)
If npm cannot run: mark UNVERIFIED and re-read each new .tsx for strict-mode issues (possibly undefined array access, unused imports, missing keys)
